title: Pour Plating of Thalassiosira pseudonana
author: Jernej Turnšek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jfncjme

steps.title: Prepare Agar and Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the components for 7 plates (300 mL total volume).

substeps.instruction: Heat 225 mL of Tp L1 medium in a ~50 °C water bath.
Autoclave 75 mL of MQ water containing 0.75 g superclean agar separately.

steps.title: Mix Agar and Medium
steps.instruction: Combine the prepared agar and medium components.

substeps.instruction: Mix the cooled agar with the Tp L1 medium.

steps.title: Prepare Cell Suspensions
steps.instruction: Prepare cell suspensions at the desired dilution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare ~0.5 mL total volume of cell suspension in 50 mL conical tubes.

steps.title: Temper Agar Mixture
steps.instruction: Cool the Tp L1-agar mixture to the appropriate pouring temperature.

substeps.instruction: Remove the mixture from the 37 °C bath.
Allow it to cool to 32-33 °C (shake frequently and monitor with a temperature gun).
Ensure the mixture does not drop to 27-28 °C, as it will begin to solidify.

steps.title: Plate the Cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate the agar and pour into plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 mL of the Tp L1-agar mixture to each cell suspension.
Pour the mixture into the plates.

steps.title: Incubate Plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates to allow colony growth.

substeps.instruction: Target a plating density of ~10^5 cells or fewer for clearly distinguishable colonies.

steps.title: Recover Single Colonies
steps.instruction: Extract individual colonies from the agar matrix.

substeps.instruction: Use a 20 uL pipette adjusted to 5 uL with narrow tips.
Carefully approach a desired colony and pipette approximately 1 mm above it to extract the colony.

steps.title: Establish Inoculum
steps.instruction: Grow an inoculum for larger liquid cultures.

substeps.instruction: Dispense the recovered colony into 1 mL Tp L1.
Grow the culture at 18 °C under a diel cycle (approximately 3 weeks for growth in a 12-well plate).
